subject: Early Retirement of Superintendent Roy Belson
overview: The School Committee accepted the early retirement of Superintendent Roy Belson and authorized a district-wide security audit after a loaded gun magazine was found at McGlynn Middle School. The meeting followed public outcry over a months-long delay in reporting the incident to the police.

items.title: Security Audit and Security Director
items.summary: The Committee voted to conduct a security audit of all Medford schools and established a new position for a security director.

items.title: Retirement of Superintendent Roy Belson
items.summary: Superintendent Roy Belson will retire early on April 30th as a compromise after he admitted to failing to notify police when ammunition was discovered in December.

items.title: Administrative Leave for School Leadership
items.summary: The principal of McGlynn Middle School was placed on administrative leave, and it was disclosed that the principal of McGlynn Elementary School also had prior knowledge of the ammunition incident.
